plan.selection: {products}, {seats, plural, one {# branch seat} other {# branch seats}}

notYours.inactiveTitle: Your restaurant’s package is inactive — ask the owner
notYours.lockedTitle: Only the owner or an admin can change the package
notYours.inactiveBody: The storefront and back office for {branch} are paused until the restaurant owner or an admin chooses a package. Nothing has been deleted, and your work comes back as soon as it is active again.
notYours.lockedBody: {branch}’s package is managed by the restaurant owner. Ask them if you need a feature that is not switched on.

replaceDialog.title: Replace your pending request?
replaceDialog.body: Your earlier request ({summary}) is withdrawn and this one goes to the Favornoms team instead.

errors.sendFailed: Could not send your request. Please try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again, then send the request.
errors.forbidden: Only the restaurant owner or an admin can change the package.
errors.planUnavailable: That package is not available any more. Reload the page and choose again.

base.name: Base
base.description: Everything you need to run one branch.

seats.title: Branches
seats.body: 1 included. Each extra branch is {price}/mo with the full feature set of your main branch.
seats.usage: Using {used} of {seats, plural, one {# seat} other {# seats}}.
seats.floor: You run {count, plural, one {# active branch} other {# active branches}}, so you cannot go below {min} seats. To give up a seat, hide a branch you no longer use: open its Branch settings and set Status to Hidden. A hidden branch does not use a seat.

summary.title: Your package
summary.trialNote: You are on the free trial. Nothing is charged until it ends.
summary.footnote: Your request goes to the Favornoms team for activation. You will be invoiced monthly.

trial.daysLeft: {days, plural, one {# day left in your free trial} other {# days left in your free trial}}
trial.body: Everything is unlocked. Choose a package below to keep it after the trial — no card needed until then.

suspended.title: Your account is not active
suspended.body: Your storefront is offline and new orders are blocked. Nothing has been deleted — choose a package below and everything comes straight back.

noTrial.title: This restaurant starts without a free trial
noTrial.body: Your account already used its 14-day free trial on another restaurant. This one stays offline until it has a package: choose one below and send the request, and the Favornoms team activates it.

renew.title: Renew your package
renew.body: Your current package is selected below. Press Request renewal to send it to the Favornoms team — nothing renews until they approve it. You can also change the package before sending.

decision.noReason: No reason was given. You can choose a package below and send a new request.

pending.title: Request waiting for the Favornoms team
pending.titleSent: Request waiting for the Favornoms team · sent {date}
pending.body: Nothing changes until it is approved. To ask for something else, change the package below and press Replace pending request.
